finding: The scenario constructs a pressure band from designed rates (arrival 23.81/s against a 20/s drain, rate ceiling 30/s) and then requires the room to observe depth above its pressure line (8). Under CPU contention the sender itself runs late — 160 frames at a 42 ms pace took 7753 ms instead of about 6720 ms — so the measured arrival rate fell to 20.64/s, barely above the drain, and peak depth reached 7. The premise was never established, and `construction.insideBand` still reads true because it is computed from the designed rates rather than the measured ones.
whyItIsDisclosedRatherThanFixed: It is not one of the two defects W-A was assigned (W-7, P-2b), it belongs to the accepted Phase 2 population probe and to the W-10/W-9 case, and the assertion that reads it (`runs the adversarial population and reads back a passing verdict`) is accepted evidence. Changing that probe's premise check is a different grant; the numbers are published here so the next reader does not have to rediscover them.
sameFamilyAs: the W-7 symptom class: a fixture whose wall-clock premise is assumed rather than re-read from measured bytes
